slices.title: Auth bootstrap and session surface
slices.intent: The pinned better-auth dependency, the server factory with email and password plus mandatory verification, a thin database adapter over the existing pool, the auth schema in the lazy ensure chain, and the lib/auth public surface (getSession, requireSession, listRoles).

symbols.name: ensureAuthSchema
symbols.expectation: Creates the six tables idempotently: user, session, account, verification (better-auth canonical shapes), roles, user_roles.

symbols.name: createAuthServer
symbols.expectation: Returns the wrapped better-auth server with email and password, mandatory verification, the verification callback wired, and verified signups assigned the guest default role.

symbols.name: getSession
symbols.expectation: Returns the session for valid cookies, null otherwise.

symbols.name: requireSession
symbols.expectation: Returns the session or a 401-style refusal.

symbols.name: listRoles
symbols.expectation: Returns all roles with ranks.

symbols.name: createServerPersistenceProvider
symbols.expectation: Modified: composes ensureAuthSchema into the lazy chain beside the five existing ensures.

deficiencies: diff 5/6: lib/persistence/server-provider.ts::createServerPersistenceProvider postcondition pins signature (connectionString: string, poolFactory?: PersistencePoolFactory): Promise<ServerPersistenceProvider> but the fresh capture is the multi-line form with poolFactory REQUIRED (the optional ? is gone in source). Neither the optionality nor the byte-exact multi-line form matches. Re-pin the after-signature to outline truth or restore the optional parameter to match the postcondition.

slices.expectation: Six auth tables exist after bootstrap; valid cookie resolves a session; missing session makes requireSession refuse; lib/auth is the only better-auth importer; dependency pinned in package.json; verified signup defaults to guest rank 1.

slices.title: Role model, rank integers, env and yaml seeds
slices.intent: The roles and user_roles tables, the ROLE_RANKS constants with anonymous 0 virtual and guest 1, learner 2, creator 3, admin 4 seeded as system rows, the ADMIN_EMAILS env seed, the server-roles.yml loader, and idempotent non-destructive reseeding where the database is truth.

symbols.expectation: The stable rank constants, anonymous virtual. Shape: { ANONYMOUS: 0, GUEST: 1, LEARNER: 2, CREATOR: 3, ADMIN: 4 }.

symbols.name: seedRoleGrants
symbols.expectation: Seeds grants idempotently, non-destructive, overriding the guest default for emails with a configured role, returns applied count.

symbols.name: listRoles
symbols.expectation: Returns all roles with ranks.

symbols.name: loadRoleDefaults
symbols.expectation: Merges the ADMIN_EMAILS env and server-roles.yml default filename into defaults.

Re-pin the after-signature byte-exact to outline truth (the batch G convention).
